ModMetaData.name: Deathrest Unbound
ModMetaData.author: Xmaxer
ModMetaData.description:
Removes the deathrest building cap. Power is the limit instead.
- No deathrest capacity: a deathresting pawn uses every deathrest building in the room, from any xenotype with the deathrest gene. - Exponential casket power: a deathrest casket draws base power x 1.5^n, where n is the number of buildings it uses. Eight buildings cost about 2.6 kW, twelve about 13 kW. - Shared buildings: deathrest buildings link to every casket in their room and can serve several deathresting pawns at once. Each casket served adds the building's power draw (and hemogen use) again. - Link management: a new "Deathrest" tab on caskets and deathrest buildings lets you switch individual links off, see what each one costs, and jump between them. - The deathrest capacity serum is no longer sold or found as loot (existing serum still works).
Everything is configurable in the mod settings: capacity, per-building stack limits, the power exponent, building power and fuel scaling, and the serum.
Works with modded deathrest buildings and caskets. Also supports Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage.
Safe to add to an existing save: existing bindings turn into casket links on load.
Requires Harmony and Biotech.
